mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (author_id, category, title, content, status, reply_count, like_count, mark_count, accepted_reply_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{authorId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content}, #{status}, #{replyCount}, #{likeCount}, #{markCount}, #{acceptedReplyId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, up.nickname AS author_nickname FROM posts p LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON p.author_id = up.user_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET author_id = #{authorId}, category = #{category}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, status = #{status}, reply_count = #{replyCount}, like_count = #{likeCount}, mark_count = #{markCount}, accepted_reply_id = #{acceptedReplyId}, created_at = #{createdAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, up.nickname AS author_nickname FROM posts p LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON p.author_id = up.user_id WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY (COALESCE(p.reply_count, 0) + COALESCE(p.like_count, 0) + COALESCE(p.mark_count, 0) + 1) / GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, p.created_at, NOW()) + 2, 2) DESC, p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size}
